title: Verify Auth Fix - Complete Flow Test
description: End-to-end verification that auth works correctly. Must use browser tools to actually test the full flow.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start dev server if not running: bun run dev
Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate to go to http://localhost:3001/login
Take screenshot - verify login page loads (not stuck on 'Loading...')
Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__form_input to enter 'wrong@email.com' in email field
Take screenshot - verify error message 'Only admin email is allowed'
Take screenshot - verify success message about magic link sent
Check server console output for magic link URL (use Bash to read recent logs)
Navigate to the magic link URL
Take screenshot - verify redirected to home page or shows logged in state
Take screenshot - verify shows 'Welcome, Admin!' with user email and sign out button
Take screenshot - verify returns to login form
Use mcp__browser-tools__getConsoleErrors to verify no JavaScript errors
